conversationalSummary.text: TODAY’s best bet is Almagreira in the evening around 19:00, but it’s a “check-first” kind of window because the wind angle isn’t great and cross-onshore can make it messy fast. I’d look at the Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam before heading out—if it doesn’t look notably cleaner than expected, I’d pass. Tide is low and dropping, so you may still get some punch on the exposed face, but only if the wind behaves. Check the cams and go with what they show.
